title: Smitty out, Al Morgan in: the string bass arrives
summary: The band updates after Duke by replacing tuba player Smitty with string bassist Al Morgan.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, that band... Let's start talking about the band.
Now, the band had changed a little bit by then. Because Smitty was gone. That's how we got Bass Morgan.
How did we get Bass Morgan?

I don't know. He was a bass player... See, Morgan was playing the string bass, and we was getting...we was a little advancin', I guess you would call it -- steppin' up. I guess we was too kind of patterned after Duke, because Duke was the hot band.
Well, Duke had Wellman Braud playing bass with him.
So I guess you decided that the bass (?) was coming in...
Right. So we got a bass fiddle.
So you got a bass fiddle. Of course, Al Morgan has since passed. I would really like to know how that transition... Now, you were the first outside Missouri to come in that band.
From Oklahoma you came in. Now, can you name that...? Smitty was in that... You were there because of the pistol, and you got the job...
Scotty, right. And poor Scotty, when he come out of jail, he didn't have no job.
Now, the next guy, as far as we see... So far, the bass player left, Smitty, for Al Morgan.
Yes. Al Morgan was the first guy to come in after Smitty.
